home.philosophyQuote: We draw on generations of Greek culinary tradition — then reimagine every dish through a modern lens, guided by the seasons and the island itself.
home.menuDesc: Seasonal Greek cooking, refined. Pastitsada, sofrito, grilled octopus, gemista — the flavours of Corfu, presented with a contemporary sensibility.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.text1: At MeZen, cooking is storytelling. We take the deep-rooted flavours of Greek cuisine and reinterpret them with modern technique and a love for the ingredients.
philosophy.text2: Local produce, seasonal ingredients, and a deep respect for tradition meet the boldness of creation.
philosophy.pillar1Text: Recipes that have defined Corfiot kitchens for generations, honoured and kept alive.
philosophy.pillar2Text: Contemporary methods, unexpected combinations, textures and flavours you won't find elsewhere.
philosophy.pillar3Text: Every evening, a table is set as if we're expecting friends — with warmth, generosity, and care.

about.title: Our Story
about.block1Text1: Tucked into a quiet lane in Corfu's old town, away from the crowds, MeZen offers a fresh take on the island's rich culinary identity.
about.block1Text2: Our stone-walled space welcomes you with warmth — every detail, from the tableware to the music, is designed to make your evening unforgettable.
about.block2Text1: We partner with the island's farmers and fishermen, choosing the best of what each season offers. From the octopus to the olive oil, every ingredient has a story.
about.block2Text2: Pastitsada, sofrito, fish fillet bianco — the classics of Corfiot cooking, reimagined with modern technique and deep respect for where they came from.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: When you make a reservation or contact us, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, and dining preferences. Our website uses essential cookies to ensure proper functionality. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information solely to manage your reservation, communicate with you about your visit, and improve your dining experience. If you subscribe to our newsletter, we will use your email to send occasional updates about seasonal menus and special events.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.content: Our website uses essential cookies required for the site to function correctly. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your reservation data for up to 12 months to improve our service and accommodate returning guests. You may request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us directly.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.content: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also object to or restrict the processing of your data. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us by phone or email.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.content:
For questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us at:
MeZen Restaurant

sections.heading: Reservations
sections.content: Reservations are recommended and can be made by phone. We hold reserved tables for 15 minutes past the booking time. For parties of six or more, please contact us directly to arrange. We reserve the right to cancel reservations without notice in exceptional circumstances.

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.content: We kindly ask that you notify us at least 4 hours in advance if you need to cancel or modify your reservation. Late cancellations or no-shows may affect future booking availability.

sections.heading: Dining Policies
sections.content: We welcome children and will do our best to accommodate dietary requirements and allergies — please inform us when booking. MeZen is a non-smoking establishment; smoking is permitted only in designated outdoor areas.

sections.heading: Private Dining
sections.content: Private dining arrangements are subject to a separate agreement, including a tailored menu and minimum spend. Cancellation terms for private events will be communicated at the time of booking.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.content: MeZen Restaurant takes every care in the preparation and service of food and beverages. However, we cannot accept liability for allergic reactions where allergen information has been provided. Guests are responsible for informing us of any allergies or dietary needs.

sections.heading: Website Use
sections.content: The content on this website is provided for general information purposes. All text, images, and design elements are the property of MeZen Restaurant and may not be reproduced without permission. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time.

sections.heading: Our Commitment
sections.content: MeZen Restaurant is committed to ensuring that our website and our dining experience are accessible to all guests, regardless of ability. We continually work to improve accessibility across all touchpoints.

sections.heading: Website Accessibility
sections.content: This website has been built with accessibility in mind, following WCAG 2.1 guidelines. Features include semantic HTML structure, keyboard navigation support, screen reader compatibility, sufficient colour contrast, and respect for reduced motion preferences.

sections.heading: At the Restaurant
sections.content: Please be aware that our restaurant is accessed via stairs. If you have specific accessibility needs — mobility, visual, hearing, or dietary — please let us know when making your reservation and we will do everything we can to ensure a comfortable experience.

sections.heading: Feedback
sections.content:
We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of MeZen Restaurant, whether online or in person. If you encounter any barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us:
